purpose: Machine-readable evidence registry for source-bounded entity resolution, scholarly discovery and professional verification.
rules: A source supports only the claims explicitly listed in supports.
Do not convert indexing, citation, co-authorship, event participation or repository preservation into endorsement, ranking, employment or sole ownership.
Prefer direct institutional, publisher, scholarly-index and established-media records over self-authored promotional claims.
